answer: An agent planning a cedar garden beside a lagoon may spawn assistants, but each assistant should inherit part of the paid soil-analysis budget. Issue signed spending capabilities with a parent ID and remaining balance. Creating a child atomically deducts its allowance from the parent, and every API call debits the resulting shared ledger; revoking a child returns only its unspent balance. A thousand aliases cannot recreate trial credits or copy an allowance. Flooding requires buying more analysis credits. Reject replayed capability IDs and give no free budget merely for opening an account.
